projects.disclaimer: All projects are personal or demo projects, not commercial client work.

showroom.title: 3D Showroom
showroom.intro: A showcase of 3D models from Build Your Own Pet, my Roblox game, made in Blender for the Roblox Creator Store. Neon parts glow like in the game. Click any model to open it in 3D: rotate, zoom and switch render passes.

showroom.keyboardHint: Keys while the showroom has focus: ←/→ rotate, +/− zoom, R reset, Space pause. Click the scene to zoom with the mouse wheel.

ai-lab.title: AI Workflow Lab
ai-lab.intro: How my projects are actually made: a team of AI agents writes the code, and I own the idea, the tasks and the quality bar. Pick a step to see who does what.

game-playground.title: Build a Pet
game-playground.intro: A taste of the part-based pet system from Build Your Own Pet. Mix parts, elements and accessories, and see what kind of creature comes out.
game-playground.designNote: Every part carries an element, and parts of the same element add up to a set bonus, so even a random build has a strategy, and the player has a reason to hunt for the next part. Rarity shows up in accessories.
game-playground.posterNote: 3D isn’t available here: the picture shows a sample pet, the list shows your build.
